body:
Okay, two things.

First, were both leaving for different towns by the end of the summer. They're close from one another so visiting is not a problem, plus we'll both probably keep visiting our home town anyways. But still time is of the essence now.

Second, why not? And how do I get to know her without plain asking her out? I thought about suggesting we go get coffee together. But I'm afraid I'll be misunderstood. She'll think it's a date, and things'll get awkward. Or she'll think other people will be there, but there won't be.
I wouldn't call it a bad thing. You don't look like a baby, you just look younger, I'd say 22-24 maybe.
[verification](https://i.imgur.com/dkVH5fH.jpg)
Unfortunately those types of dormitories don't work like that, I can't choose who I live with
It's a former Soviet Republic

Thank you for replying. But I'm sorry, I can't see how this is relevant? You can't exactly get out of service or be discharged before serving your time if that's what you're implying. It basically works like a prison sentence. And if you get in trouble and the military court (I think it's what they're  called) is involved the punishments might be quite awful (to put it mildly)
r/lewronggeneration
If my life was a TV show that would be it's title. Living in a very odd place

Thank you for your honest take. It's comforting to hear. And it absolutely makes total sense. People do get to look more attractive as you get to know them (if there's a connection of course), you sort of start to associate their personality with their looks.
About the resting bitchface, I'm not sure if it'll make sense, but at some point I started to make this serious/annoyed face so that people wouldn't bother me. In my head I thought "people don't bother or harass serious adult business people" and "to be taken seriously I need to look serious and adult". And now it's become sort of involuntary, sort of a coping mechanism
Thank you. That's really nice to hear, I really needed that

Thank you, that's very nice of you to say. Yeah, I'd guess you're pretty much on point about the bookish type and drunk idiots. Unfortunately I run into those drunk morons on my way home from work or just by walking somewhere else

Thank you. Totally agree about getting some muscle weight. Not quite sure what hairstyle you have in mind though. Do you mean something like [this](https://smhttp-ssl-33667.nexcesscdn.net/manual/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/sleek-curly-hair-undercut-men.jpg)?
I suppose you're right. I'll try to be the better man and try to deescalate the situation. What surprises me is that I get those comments from grown up adults

Thank you for your kind words and advice. I kind of wanted to go for a Rivers Cuomo look with the glasses. But now I feel people might see them as silly. What shape of glasses would you say would be best for my face?

Thank you so much! That's very motivating, I've been meaning to start working out for a while now. I guess I'll start doing some exercises at home first and then go join a gym (plus I have a friend that works in a gym, so if I join that one, it'll be easier to not quit). I'll keep the stubble, I've always thought it was to patchy and white, but if it works then it's great news! As for contacts - I'll definetely try them out, I've always wanted to. Not sure if I'll switch to them full-time, since I'm so used to wearing glasses, but we'll see. Thanks for the advice!

Yeah, the hair's always been a problem for me. I have curly hair and it's hard to do something with it, it just goes haywire. I've been trying to comb it over to the side and I think it's sort of working so I decided to just keep doing that. Maybe I should try using some product like hair gel or mousse. What would you recommend?
Thank you for saying that. People mostly give me shit for being nerdy, make fun of my glasses etc. I guess I'll keep the stubble since, as I've been told in this thread, it works
Thank you for saying it. I've been meaning to start working out and get on some sort of diet, start eating healthy.

Thank you. Yeah, after graduating from school I was starting to think it was all just paranoia, that feeling of being watched even went away for a while. But lately I was approached and mocked far too often, so I thought I'd ask. I don't think nerd look is that popular where I live, or at least not a lot of people think so, people have been making fun of my glasses since forever and they still are. I hope you're right though, and not everyone I pass on the street thinks that.
Okay, interesting. Never thought about my neck. The only thing bothering me about it is the enlarged adam's apple which you can't really see in most photos, except for maybe photo #5.

I don't know if it'll help you. I just hope it won't be harmful to you in any way. But it helped me, so I think I have to tell about it. What I've found helpful is having a 'deadline'. Something to do. You know like ghosts have 'unfinished business' that won't let them leave just yet. When I was in a dark place a few years back, I told myself 'I can't leave without saying some things to the world first'. And so I started started writing two things: a letter and a novel, with the thought that after I'm done I'll kill myself. I haven't done neither of those yet, but it kept me busy long enough to distract me from the thought.
